nodes.description: SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b): performs checked addition c = a + b with require(c >= a).
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b): performs checked subtraction c = a - b with require(b <= a).
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b): performs checked multiplication c = a * b with require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b): performs checked division c = a / b with require(b > 0).
address public owner: current owner, set to msg.sender in constructor and updated by acceptOwnership.
address public newOwner: pending owner set by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
Owned constructor: sets owner = msg.sender.
transferOwnership(address _newOwner) onlyOwner: stages a new owner in newOwner.
acceptOwnership(): requires msg.sender == newOwner, emits OwnershipTransferred and promotes newOwner to owner.
string public symbol: token symbol 'BENS' set in constructor.
string public name: token name set in constructor.
uint8 public decimals: token decimals set to 18 in constructor.
uint public _totalSupply: fixed total supply minted to the deployer-designated address in constructor.
mapping(address => uint) balances: token balances mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowed: ERC20 allowances mutated by approve, transferFrom and approveAndCall.
BENS constructor: initialises symbol, name, decimals, _totalSupply and pre-mints the entire supply.
totalSupply() constant: returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) constant: returns balances[tokenOwner].
transfer(address to, uint tokens): debits msg.sender and credits to using safeSub/safeAdd.
approve(address spender, uint tokens): writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): moves tokens using the caller's allowance and updates balances.
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) constant: returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): sets allowance then invokes spender.receiveApproval externally.
function() public payable: always reverts, rejecting plain ETH transfers.
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) onlyOwner: external call to ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens).
msg.sender captured as the initial owner in the Owned constructor.
msg.sender used by the onlyOwner modifier and by acceptOwnership's newOwner check.
msg.sender used as the source account in BENS.transfer.
msg.sender used as the allowance owner in BENS.approve.
msg.sender used as the spender whose allowance is checked in BENS.transferFrom.
msg.sender used as allowance owner and as the 'from' argument of the external receiveApproval callback.
Arithmetic addition c = a + b inside safeAdd with a manual require-based overflow guard.
Arithmetic subtraction c = a - b inside safeSub with a manual require-based underflow guard.
Arithmetic multiplication c = a * b inside safeMul with a manual overflow guard.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) executed after allowance state is written; a reentrancy sink.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an owner-supplied, potentially malicious token contract.
Parameter 'to' of BENS.transfer: destination of the credit.
Parameter 'tokens' of BENS.transfer: amount debited from msg.sender.
Parameter 'spender' of BENS.approve: allowance key.
Parameter 'tokens' of BENS.approve: allowance value.
Parameter 'from' of BENS.transferFrom: account debited.
Parameter 'to' of BENS.transferFrom: account credited.
Parameter 'tokens' of BENS.transferFrom: amount moved.
Parameter 'spender' of BENS.approveAndCall: allowance key and target contract of the external call.
Parameter 'tokens' of BENS.approveAndCall: allowance value.
Parameter 'data' of BENS.approveAndCall: opaque bytes forwarded to receiveApproval.
Parameter 'tokenAddress' of transferAnyERC20Token: address of the external token contract called.
Parameter 'tokens' of transferAnyERC20Token: amount forwarded to the external token.
Parameter 'tokenOwner' of BENS.balanceOf: balance lookup key.
Parameter 'tokenOwner' of BENS.allowance: allowance lookup key.
Parameter 'spender' of BENS.allowance: allowance lookup key.
Parameter '_newOwner' of Owned.transferOwnership: staged owner address.
Parameter 'a' of SafeMath.safeAdd: left operand of the addition.
Parameter 'b' of SafeMath.safeAdd: right operand of the addition.
Return local 'c' of SafeMath.safeAdd holding a + b.
Return local 'c' of SafeMath.safeSub holding a - b.
Return local 'c' of SafeMath.safeMul holding a * b.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, making the caller the privileged account.
Owned.constructor writes the owner state variable.
transferOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner which compares msg.sender to owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before promoting ownership.
_newOwner parameter drives the transferOwnership call.
transferOwnership writes the staged owner into newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner, moving privileged control.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0).
BENS constructor sets the fixed _totalSupply minted to the designated address.
BENS constructor sets the symbol string.
BENS constructor sets the name string.
BENS constructor sets the decimals value.
BENS constructor pre-mints the entire supply into balances of the hardcoded address.
totalSupply() reads _totalSupply in its computation.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
tokenOwner parameter is the balanceOf lookup key.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
tokenOwner parameter keys the allowance lookup.
spender parameter keys the allowance lookup.
transfer uses msg.sender as the debited account.
transfer reads and writes balances[msg.sender].
tokens parameter is subtracted from the caller balance via safeSub.
transfer invokes safeSub for the debit arithmetic.
safeSub result is written back into balances[msg.sender].
to parameter is the credit key for the safeAdd call.
transfer invokes safeAdd for the credit arithmetic.
safeAdd result is written into balances[to].
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
spender parameter is the inner allowance key.
tokens parameter is stored as the allowance value.
transferFrom uses msg.sender to look up and decrement the spender allowance.
transferFrom reads and writes allowed[from][msg.sender].
tokens parameter is subtracted via safeSub in transferFrom.
transferFrom invokes safeSub for the debit arithmetic.
safeSub result decrements the spender allowance.
from parameter is the debited balance key.
to parameter is the credited balance key.
transferFrom invokes safeAdd for the credit arithmetic.
approveAndCall uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
spender parameter is the inner allowance key.
tokens parameter is stored as the allowance value.
approveAndCall performs an external call to spender after writing the allowance.
spender parameter, fully attacker-controlled, determines the external callee contract.
The receiveApproval callback lets the callee re-enter the token with attacker-controlled msg.sender.
transferAnyERC20Token executes an external ERC20 transfer call.
tokenAddress parameter selects the external contract being called.
tokens parameter is forwarded to the external token transfer.
safeAdd executes the addition operation.
Parameter a is the left operand of the addition.
Parameter b is the right operand of the addition.
Addition result is stored into local c.
safeSub executes the subtraction operation.
Subtraction result is stored into local c.
safeMul executes the multiplication operation.
Multiplication result is stored into local c.
